content: If J1939NmChannelUsesAddressArbitration is enabled, a call to J1939 N m_RxIndication indicating reception of an AddressClaimed PG with Specification of Network Management for SAE J1939 AUTOSAR CP R20 - 11 19 of 57 Document ID 612 : AUTOSAR_SWS_SAEJ1939NetworkManagement one of the sour ce addresses configured via J1939NmNodePreferredAddress and a payload that has a lower numerical value than the NAME for this source address configured via J1939NmNode NameXxx shall induce a state change of the according NodeChannel to the sub state ‘AcLost ’ of state ‘Offline’.
